as_told.title: UFO sightings around nuclear sites: Chernobyl and Bariloche 1995

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Robert Hastings, a researcher who writes about UFOs and nuclear weapons, has an appendix in his book listing six to eight civilian nuclear power sites where UFOs were reported, including a famous case at Bariloche in Argentina. In another episode Michels mentions similar reports at Chernobyl and Bariloche without crediting Hastings, dating the Bariloche sighting to 1995. If true, it would mean the interest in nuclear sites reaches beyond military bases to ordinary power plants.
